what: Runs of the two denominator tasks on Kaggle Benchmarks, as reported by the site owner from the Kaggle notebook output. Not re-run by anyone else.

runs.caveat: All 40 items ran in one growing conversation (input 95 -> 4,095 tokens), so later items saw earlier ones. Fixed afterwards: one conversation per item.

runs.task: integrations/kaggle/denominator_grid_task.py (30 items, 105 candidate denominators, 8 with no matching cell)
runs.model: the notebook's default model (not stated in the pasted output; the first run's default was google/gemini-3.8-flash)
runs.caveat: One conversation per item. Whether the model used a code tool is not visible in the pasted output.

reading: Both tasks are at ceiling for a small current model: given the table, working out which denominator produced a figure is not where it fails. The failures this site has logged from answer engines are of another kind: figures taken from pages that state no denominator, and a later edition not found (eval/answer-engine-log/). These tasks therefore do not separate models and are not offered as a leaderboard; they stay as a published sanity check with this result attached.
